links.outcome: Potential harm of errors in LLM-generated ward round records versus physician records
links.effect: Overall potential harm scores low (<1 point) without significant differences (P=.38), but high-harm records significantly more frequent in both LLM groups than physician group (P=.02).
links.quote: Overall potential harm scores were low across all 3 groups (<1 point), without significant differences (P=.38), although high-harm records were significantly more frequent in both LLM groups than in the physician group (P=.02).

screen.reason: Evaluated the quality and safety of LLM-generated initial senior physician ward round records against human physician records using retrospective clinical data, but did not experimentally test an organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
